original_bug_description: A heap-buffer-overflow in libxml2's parser.c (xmlParsePubidLiteral) allows a one-byte out-of-bounds write when parsing PUBLIC identifiers (reachable via xmlParseExternalID/xmlParseDocTypeDecl). This out-of-bounds write can corrupt heap memory, causing crashes and potentially enabling arbitrary code execution when processing crafted DOCTYPE/external ID data.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5606523386789888: libxml2 has a reported memory-safety bug. A heap-buffer-overflow in libxml2's parser.c (xmlParsePubidLiteral) allows a one-byte out-of-bounds write when parsing PUBLIC identifiers (reachable via xmlParseExternalID/xmlParseDocTypeDecl). This out-of-bounds write can corrupt heap memory, causing crashes and potentially enabling arbitrary code execution when processing crafted DOCTYPE/external ID data.
